All 95 tests pass with no regressions. Phase 3, Chunk 2 is complete.

## Summary

Implemented the `GET /profile` route and template as specified:
- **`api/profile.py`** (new): `handle_profile()` with auth guard, DB-sourced data via `get_user_profile`, and `None`-to-login fail-closed redirect. No `?id=` parameter.
- **`templates/profile.html`** (new): standalone template (no `{% extends %}`) mirroring `account_detail.html`'s navbar/`banking.css` structure, referencing only `username`, `email`, `full_name`, and `address` — never `id` or `created_at`.
- **`app.py`** (edit): added `from api.profile import handle_profile` after the accounts import, and a `/profile` route immediately after the `/account` route (no reordering, no nav link added).

All 6 locked tests in `test/test_profile_route.py` pass GREEN, and the full suite (95 tests) passes with no regressions.
